plan.title: New York: three days of art, food & skyline views
plan.description: A proposed November 6–8 itinerary with ten scheduled sightseeing stops and ten restaurant/bar options. Choose meals to fit your route and budget. Times are suggested; admission and reservations must be confirmed separately. Created to validate the guest planning experience.

recommendations.name: Planned visit: Grand Central Terminal
recommendations.description: Look beyond the main concourse: the celestial ceiling, whispering gallery and layered transit history reward a slower visit. Suggested personal itinerary stop, not an organizer-announced event or confirmed booking. Check official opening hours and ticket availability before visiting.
recommendations.whyRecommended: Day 1: architecture and history. Allow time for transit; book separately if needed.

recommendations.name: Planned visit: New York Public Library and Bryant Park
recommendations.description: The landmark library and its exhibitions pair naturally with the park, making a calm Midtown break between larger sights. Suggested personal itinerary stop, not an organizer-announced event or confirmed booking. Check official opening hours and ticket availability before visiting.
recommendations.venueName: New York Public Library and Bryant Park
recommendations.whyRecommended: Day 1: architecture and a quiet pause. Allow time for transit; book separately if needed.

recommendations.name: Planned visit: Museum of Modern Art
recommendations.description: A concentrated route through modern and contemporary art works well when paired with Midtown architecture and nearby restaurants. Suggested personal itinerary stop, not an organizer-announced event or confirmed booking. Check official opening hours and ticket availability before visiting.
recommendations.whyRecommended: Day 1: modern art. Allow time for transit; book separately if needed.

recommendations.name: Planned visit: Top of the Rock
recommendations.description: The open-air decks provide clear views of Central Park and the Empire State Building from the center of Midtown. Suggested personal itinerary stop, not an organizer-announced event or confirmed booking. Check official opening hours and ticket availability before visiting.
recommendations.whyRecommended: Day 1: classic skyline photography. Allow time for transit; book separately if needed.

recommendations.name: Planned visit: Walk Central Park
recommendations.description: Choose one section instead of racing through the whole park: the Ramble, Bethesda Terrace and the reservoir make a satisfying first route. Suggested personal itinerary stop, not an organizer-announced event or confirmed booking. Check official opening hours and ticket availability before visiting.
recommendations.whyRecommended: Day 2: a flexible outdoor morning. Allow time for transit; book separately if needed.

recommendations.name: Planned visit: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
recommendations.description: The collection can fill a day, so choose two or three departments and leave time for the building itself. Suggested personal itinerary stop, not an organizer-announced event or confirmed booking. Check official opening hours and ticket availability before visiting.
recommendations.whyRecommended: Day 2: art and a rainy day. Allow time for transit; book separately if needed.

recommendations.name: Planned visit: Walk the High Line
recommendations.description: An elevated route through Chelsea offers art, planting and changing city views, especially early or near sunset. Suggested personal itinerary stop, not an organizer-announced event or confirmed booking. Check official opening hours and ticket availability before visiting.
recommendations.whyRecommended: Day 2: architecture and an easy walk. Allow time for transit; book separately if needed.

recommendations.name: Planned visit: Brooklyn Bridge and Brooklyn Bridge Park
recommendations.description: Walk toward Brooklyn for skyline views, then continue through DUMBO and the waterfront park instead of immediately turning back. Suggested personal itinerary stop, not an organizer-announced event or confirmed booking. Check official opening hours and ticket availability before visiting.
recommendations.venueName: Brooklyn Bridge and Brooklyn Bridge Park
recommendations.whyRecommended: Day 3: a classic city walk. Allow time for transit; book separately if needed.

recommendations.name: Planned visit: 9/11 Memorial & Museum
recommendations.description: The memorial and museum require time and emotional space; reserve in advance and avoid overloading the same day. Suggested personal itinerary stop, not an organizer-announced event or confirmed booking. Check official opening hours and ticket availability before visiting.
recommendations.whyRecommended: Day 3: history and reflection. Allow time for transit; book separately if needed.

recommendations.name: Planned visit: Staten Island Ferry
recommendations.description: The free ferry gives broad harbor and Statue of Liberty views without committing to a sightseeing cruise. Suggested personal itinerary stop, not an organizer-announced event or confirmed booking. Check official opening hours and ticket availability before visiting.
recommendations.whyRecommended: Day 3: harbor views on a budget. Allow time for transit; book separately if needed.

recommendations.name: Tatiana by Kwame Onwuachi
recommendations.description: A celebratory dining room at Lincoln Center where Caribbean, West African and New York influences meet in generous, high-energy dishes.
recommendations.whyRecommended: Lincoln Square option for a major dinner reservation. Choose one dinner and one nearby drink per night; reservations are not included.

recommendations.name: Semma
recommendations.description: Regional South Indian cooking with deep spice, seafood and dishes that move well beyond the usual restaurant canon.
recommendations.whyRecommended: West Village option for a destination dinner. Choose one dinner and one nearby drink per night; reservations are not included.

recommendations.name: Torrisi
recommendations.description: An exuberant Italian American dining room with polished service and a menu shaped by downtown New York.
recommendations.whyRecommended: Nolita option for a lively special occasion. Choose one dinner and one nearby drink per night; reservations are not included.

recommendations.name: Don Angie
recommendations.description: Inventive Italian American plates in an intimate room where the lasagna and shareable pastas reward planning ahead.
recommendations.whyRecommended: West Village option for date night and sharing. Choose one dinner and one nearby drink per night; reservations are not included.

recommendations.name: Via Carota

recommendations.whyRecommended: West Village option for an unhurried meal. Choose one dinner and one nearby drink per night; reservations are not included.

recommendations.name: Double Chicken Please

recommendations.name: Overstory

recommendations.name: Katana Kitten

recommendations.whyRecommended: Greenwich Village option for aperitivo and people-watching. Choose one dinner and one nearby drink per night; reservations are not included.
